figurative_meaning_en: Hypocritical meditation or pretense of meditation
example_sentences_in_bangla: তার বকধ্যান দেখে বুঝলাম সে আসলে কোনো ভক্তি করে না।
রাজনীতিতে অনেকে বকধ্যান করে জনগণকে প্রতারিত করে।
example_sentences_in_english: From his hypocritical meditation, I realized he has no real devotion.
Many politicians engage in hypocritical meditation to deceive the public.
history: This idiom originates from ancient Sanskrit texts and fables, like the Panchatantra, where a crane (বক) stands motionless on one leg in shallow water, appearing to meditate but actually waiting to catch fish, symbolizing false piety.
note: The term draws from natural observation of herons or cranes, common in Bengali folklore.
